description:
Use this when you need a deterministic Brazil Brazil federal executive public administration (SIPEC) result. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when this is not a universal Brazilian private-employer calendar; state, municipal, sector, employer and private payroll schedules are not inferred.
What it computes: Checks a date against the Saturday-Sunday weekend baseline and exact 2026-2026 authority events.
Example user requests: Brazil: Tiradentes.
Inputs: date (date).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2026-04-21"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: is_working_day = not an official Saturday/Sunday weekend date and no exact authority event
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/brazil-federal-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/brazil-federal-working-day.md
name: check_br_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

holiday_policy.description: Portaria MGI federal public-administration national holidays and ponto facultativo events; optional events are preserved as federal-scope optional days

is_working_day.description: Monday-Friday with no event in this pinned authority scope.

substitute_day_policy.description: No private-sector, state or municipal substitute-day rule is inferred

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Brazil Working Day
